description: onTeardownWorkspace and onReloadConfig closures on AppModel capture [model] strongly, creating a retain cycle (AppModel → closure → AppModel).
reason: AppModel lives for the full application lifetime, so the cycle never causes a leak in practice. Fix would be [weak model] with guard, but provides no runtime benefit.

description: AppModel.init reads profiles.json twice at startup on the happy path: migrateIfNeeded() does a stat+early-return, then loadMetadata() does a full read. migrateIfNeeded() could return ProfilesMetadata it already loaded to eliminate the second read.
reason: Single extra disk read on startup only. Not on a hot path. Not user-perceptible.

description: ProfileStore is not @MainActor but its factory methods (workspaceStore(for:), configFile(for:)) are @MainActor. The class can be called from any context without a compile-time error on non-factory methods.
reason: All current callers are @MainActor (AppModel.init, switchProfile, createProfile). No correctness issue today. Annotating the whole class @MainActor would be cleaner but is a wider refactor.

description: Step-numbering comments in switchProfile describe WHAT each block does (matching numbered spec steps) rather than WHY the ordering constraint matters.
reason: The ordered-step documentation is acceptable for a complex operation with a safety-critical ordering invariant. The comments aid cross-referencing with the spec.

description: profiles.count > 1 guard appears in three places: AppModel.deleteProfile, HoottyApp command handler, and the menu .disabled modifier. The command handler guard is intentional to avoid showing a no-op NSAlert.
reason: Each guard serves a different purpose. The duplication is intentional and documented by context.

description: Pre-existing: NSWorkspace.shared.open(ConfigFile.defaultFileURL) in HoottyApp opens the legacy root config path, not the active profile's config file. After migration, this opens a non-existent or stale path.
location: Sources/Hootty/HoottyApp.swift (Edit Config command handler, not part of this diff)
reason: Pre-existing bug, outside this blueprint's scope. Should be fixed in a separate change: replace with NSWorkspace.shared.open(appModel.configFile.fileURL).

description: nextProfileName(base:) and nextWorkspaceName() both disambiguate names with numeric suffixes using slightly different algorithms. Could share a private static disambiguatedName(_:among:) helper.
reason: The algorithms differ: nextWorkspaceName extracts trailing integers and scans from 1; nextProfileName uses Set membership and scans from 2. Merging would require unifying the convention. Low priority until a third named-entity type appears.
